Automated DOLE Premiums

Lightweight

Fast

Dashboards load in the blink of an eye. Events are stored in ClickHouse, a database built for analytics and far faster than traditional data warehouses.

Government IDs (SSS, PhilHealth, TIN), bank details, and employee records are encrypted at rest with AES-256 and full audit trails.

Secure

Frequently Asked Questions

Everything you need to know

Got questions about setup, privacy, tracking, or revenue attribution? We've got answers.

Yes. Pay calculations strictly adhere to the Philippine Labor Code and DOLE handbook: 8-hour regular days, 125% ordinary overtime, 130% rest day and special non-working holidays, 150% special day on rest day, 200% regular holidays, 260% regular holiday on rest day, and 10% night differential (10 PM–6 AM). Service Incentive Leave (SIL) and 13th-month pay accruals are also built in.
